messages:
sara: fyi forwarding procurement email from Acme — they require a PO before we can issue an invoice. card attempt was declined so they want net-30 on PO. stamping/formatting required: PO#, vendor name, billing address, VAT ID. they said: 'we cannot process invoices without a PO; finance will reject otherwise.'
acme-procurement: Confirming — our procurement policy is strict. we can provide PO if invoice draft includes exact vendor legal name and VAT. email for PO uplift: procurement@acme.com. hold activation until PO is on file.
billing-bot: AUTOMATED: invoice generation attempted for acct acme_corp — status: failed. reason: missing purchase_order. invoice_id=inv_2025_7788
jess: tagging finance — can we generate a provisional/draft invoice that contains placeholder PO field so procurement can approve and send PO back? also need VAT handling — is regional tax applied?
sara: yes customer asked for a proforma or draft with vendor legal name + VAT. they also want invoice sent to procurement@acme.com and AP contact ap@acme.com.
tom: Sales here — we need to make sure we don't activate paid seats before PO comes in. Acme's legal signed the SOW but procurement refuses to pay without PO on invoice. can ops delay seat provisioning? @eng-sre?
jess: Finance prefers to issue invoice and mark it 'Pending PO' so we have a record, then attach PO when received. can billing team add metadata.purchase_order blank and allow update?
billing-bot: ACTIONABLE: billing API supports updating invoice.metadata.purchase_order before finalizing if invoice.status == 'draft'. endpoint: POST /v1/invoices/{id}/metadata
sara: thanks — I'll send them a draft invoice. question: do we need a signed PO (scanned) or is PO# enough? acme-procurement: PO# is sufficient, must match invoice.PO field and show approval date.
tom: also flag: VAT — they included EU VAT ID. finance, please confirm reverse-charge vs vendor-assessed tax. if we need to reissue with VAT lines that may delay.
jess: noted. i'll prepare draft invoice with VAT lines disabled and VAT ID in billing notes for now, set status=draft, metadata.purchase_order="" and send to procurement@acme.com with instructions to reply with PO# and scanned PO if required.
sara: i'll ping Acme with draft and expiry 14 days. will update thread when PO received. :white_check_mark:
